title: NZ MBIE Determination 2025/033 (comparative): notice to fix for roof flashings and wall cladding, form and content
jurisdiction: New Zealand (Building Act 2004); Dunedin City Council; comparative only, not Alberta
code_edition: NZ Building Code (Schedule 1, Building Regulations 1992) as cited; E2/AS1 third edition, amendment 10 as cited in Appendix A
source_url_note: Building CodeHub resource page for the same MBIE determination (Information provider: MBIE); the building.govt.nz determination page is WAF-blocked for this worker.

facts.text: The determination considers a notice to fix for roof flashings and wall cladding systems on a new two-storey detached dwelling.
The notice to fix NTF-2024-257 is challenged for its form, content, specified persons, remedy and timeframe.
The owner and the first and second licensed building practitioners are specified persons under section 163.
The notice did not fairly or fully inform recipients of the particulars of the contravention or include an appropriate remedy.
Appendix A summarises the roofing and cladding issues, such as sagging window support, weatherboard fixing at floor joists and sealing.
